name: Valencia
tagline: Mediterranean Living at Half the Price of Barcelona
description: Valencia offers everything expats love about coastal Spain — paella on the beach, world-class architecture at the City of Arts & Sciences, and a genuine Mediterranean lifestyle — but at a fraction of Barcelona or Madrid prices. Spain's third-largest city combines historic charm with modern innovation, making it one of Europe's best-kept FIRE secrets.

quickFacts.visa: Non-Lucrative Visa (must show sufficient funds, no work allowed). Beckham Law may apply for new tax residents. Path to permanent residency and citizenship after 10 years.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very Safe — one of Spain's safest large cities, standard urban precautions apply
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Valencia Airport (VLC) — 15 min from city center
quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean with mild winters (10-16°C) and hot summers (25-33°C). Over 300 days of sunshine per year.

housing.description: Room in a shared flat, Benimaclet / outer Russafa / Extramurs

dining.description: Mostly home cooking with menú del día lunches and tapas out

healthcare.description: Compliant NLV private policy, no copays, Spanish insurer (Adeslas/ASISA)

transportation.description: Subsidized EMT bus + Valenbisi bike-share in a flat, very bike-friendly city

entertainment.description: Free Turia park cycling, Malvarrosa beach days, and Fallas street celebrations

1M.lifestyle: A bright, budget-conscious Valencia base — a room in a shared flat in Benimaclet or the outer Russafa/Extramurs fringe, both walkable and full of local character. Menú del día lunches and home cooking, movement by Valenbisi bike-share and the subsidized EMT bus, and a compliant NLV private policy carried. As one of Spain's most affordable big cities, beach days at Malvarrosa and cheap meals out fit easily into this tier.

dining.description: Dining out regularly at Russafa's acclaimed spots with weekend beachside paella

healthcare.description: Mid-tier no-copay private plan, wider network (Sanitas/DKV)

transportation.description: Subsidized EMT bus + Valenbisi bike-share in a flat, very bike-friendly city

entertainment.description: Oceanogràfic visits, marina sailing lessons, and Albufera weekend trips

2M.lifestyle: A studio or small one-bedroom in Russafa or Extramurs. Dining out regularly at the district's acclaimed spots and weekend paella by the beach, comprehensive private cover, and a weekend rental car for the Albufera wetlands. An easy, comfortable rhythm with little day-to-day cost worry.

dining.description: Regular dining at the city's better restaurants

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private plan, broad hospital network, fast specialist access

entertainment.description: Sailing-club membership and season tickets at the Palau de les Arts

3M.lifestyle: A central one-bedroom in Russafa or L'Eixample. Regular dining at the city's better restaurants, a broad-network private plan, the transit pass with taxis plus a weekend rental car for Albufera and countryside excursions, and season tickets at the Palau de les Arts. Valencia's affordability makes this a genuinely affluent daily life with real travel headroom.

dining.description: Frequent dining at the city's best restaurants

healthcare.description: Premium private cover or entry-level international plan

transportation.description: Add a car, with a driver for occasions at 10M

entertainment.description: Premium cultural experiences, galleries, and coastal getaways

5M.lifestyle: A premium renovated one-bedroom in a prime-central setting or near the City of Arts & Sciences. Frequent dining at the city's best restaurants, VIP private cover, regular household help, and a luxury car for coastal drives. Valencia's low costs mean the budget stretches to upper-affluent living with ample room for travel and entertainment.

housing.description: Luxury 1–2BR, Eixample / Gran Vía / Ciutat Vella

dining.description: Private-chef dining and the finest Valencian tables

transportation.description: Add a car, with a driver for occasions at 10M

entertainment.description: Art, boating, and premium cultural-and-social life

10M.lifestyle: A luxury one-to-two-bedroom in the old town or a waterfront address. Private-chef dining, top international health cover, a premium car plus private transfers with a driver for occasions, full household help, and lavish discretionary spend. Valencia is among the most affordable cities on this list, so this budget outruns what the city can realistically absorb.
